name: eudr
description: Check farm plots for forest loss after the EU Deforestation Regulation cut-off, find missing Article 9 information per supplier, and prepare a signed Annex II Due Diligence Statement. Some tools do more than read: preparing a statement spends credits and publishes a 7-day share link, plot and farm tools send plot geometry to emem.dev for measurement, a supplier request creates a link that lets its holder submit data, and setting a farm boundary replaces the old one. The README lists which tool does what.
